units.source_text: 次年二月，皇太子冷泉院举行冠礼。

en.t: In the second month of the following year, Crown Prince Reizei held his coming-of-age ceremony.

units.source_text: 皇太子年方十一，然而长得比年龄更大。

en.t: The Crown Prince was only eleven, yet he looked older than his years.

units.source_text: 举止端详，容貌清丽，酷肖源氏大纳言，竟像一个模子里印出来的。

en.t: His bearing was composed and his features were pure and beautiful; he so closely resembled Genji the Grand Counselor that he seemed to have been cast from the same mold.

units.source_text: 这一对人物互相照映，光彩焕发，世人盛传，以为美谈。

en.t: The two of them shone all the more brightly beside one another, and people everywhere spoke of it as a charming story.

units.source_text: 然而藤壶皇后听了甚是难当，只觉得心中隐隐作痛。

en.t: Yet when Empress Fujitsubo heard this, it was very hard for her to bear, and she felt a dull ache deep in her heart.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝看了皇太子的容姿，也深为赞美，便亲切地把让位之事对他说了。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku, seeing the Crown Prince's appearance, also praised him deeply and kindly spoke to him about the matter of abdication.

units.source_text: 到了是月二十过后，让位的消息突然发表，皇太后吃了一惊。

en.t: After the twentieth day of that month, the news of the abdication was suddenly announced, and the Empress Dowager was startled.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝安慰她道：“我虽辞去尊位，但今后可得安闲地孝养母后，务请放心。”

en.t: Emperor Suzaku comforted her, saying, "Although I am giving up the exalted throne, from now on I will be able to care for you peacefully and at leisure, so please set your mind at ease."

units.source_text: 皇太子即位之后，承香殿女御所生的皇子立为皇太子。

en.t: After the Crown Prince ascended the throne, the prince born to the lady of the Shokyoden was appointed Crown Prince.
